description: Text styled as a title that cannot be seen: display none, visibility hidden, visually hidden by clipping, opacity 0, off screen, font size 0, transparent, clipped by its container, the hidden attribute, inside a closed details. Candidates come from what is painted, so none is reported. Text in the exact colour of the background behind it is painted, and may sit over a picture the styles do not tell of: it is a candidate at info, with the flag sameColourAsBackground.
